preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 20000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 300000 for n in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, 2*t+1, 2)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 300000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a) for a in [list(map(int, lines[i].split())) for i in range(2, 2*t+2, 2)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array a contains n integers, each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 300000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((ans == -1) or (1 <= ans <= n) for ans, n in zip([int(x) for x in stdout.strip().split()], [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, 2*t+1, 2)]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either -1 or a 1-based index between 1 and n for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all((ans == -1 and max(a) == min(a)) or (ans != -1 and a[ans-1] == max(a) and (ans > 1 and a[ans-2] < a[ans-1] or ans < n and a[ans] < a[ans-1])) for ans, a, n in zip([int(x) for x in stdout.strip().split()], [list(map(int, lines[i].split())) for i in range(2, 2*t+2, 2)], [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, 2*t+1, 2)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the output is -1, all piranhas have the same size (no dominant piranha exists). If the output is an index, that piranha has the maximum size and has at least one adjacent neighbor with a strictly smaller size, making it a valid dominant candidate.
